items.claim: Alexander Popic was knocked out by Jamal Hill on Dana White's Contender Series in 2019.
items.quote: Popic got knocked out by Jamal Hill way back in 2019 on Dana White's Contender Series.

items.claim: Alexander Popic is significantly smaller than Jovan Lecca, standing 6'2" as a natural 205er facing a full 265 lb heavyweight.
items.quote: Alexander Popic, he is 6'2", but he's a 205er. Alexander Popic is way outsized by Joson Lecca.

items.claim: Jovan Lecca is a large heavyweight standing 6'5" with a 79-inch reach and weighing 265 lbs.
Jovan Lecca is well-rounded, possessing wrestling and ground-and-pound abilities in addition to his knockout power.
items.quote: Lecca can knock people out and ground and pound and wrestle. He's not just one-dimensional.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira uses straighter punches, better range, and is faster to the target than Oban Elliott.
items.quote: Michael Oliveira, lot straighter of a shooter, knows how to use his range a little bit, faster to the target.

items.claim: Michael Oliveira is undefeated as a professional with a 9-0 record including eight knockout wins.
items.quote: Eight wins by knockout. Nine and oh as a pro.
